```
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|              READY-TO-WEAR (RTW) / PRET-A-PORTER                 |
|                                                                  |
|  DEFINITION: Garments made in standard sizes, in production      |
|  runs, not for a specific individual -- available                |
|  for immediate purchase off the rack.                            |
|                                                                  |
|  EMERGENCE: 1950s-1960s (designer RTW)                           |
|  YSL Rive Gauche (1966) = first luxury designer RTW store        |
|                                                                  |
|  SPECTRUM                                                        |
|  Designer RTW (Prada, Gucci, Chanel RTW)  $500-$5,000            |
|  Contemporary (Theory, Cos, Club Monaco)  $100-$500              |
|  High street (H&M, Zara, Gap)             $20-$100               |
|  Fast fashion / Ultra-fast                $5-$30                 |
|                                                                  |
|  SIZE SYSTEMS (the critical enabling technology)                 |
|  US: 0-18 (women); XS-XXL                                        |
|  UK: 6-20                                                        |
|  IT: 36-52                                                       |
|  FR: 34-50                                                       |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
